card.name: Descriptive nature and object details
card.fires_on: Scattered words in physical descriptions of nature, structures or objects, such as a preposition or comma after a place, size or position phrase. It also fires on the start of a split word.

modes.label: Linking words in descriptions
modes.description: A preposition, number or punctuation mark inside a description of where or how something is placed or built.
modes.example: The royal loge (hünkâr mahfil) is supported by<< ten>> marble columns.

modes.label: Partway through split words
modes.description: The first piece of a word broken into parts, in descriptive text.
modes.example: During winter, long icicles<< g>>listened on the tunnel walls.

modes.label: Distance or location phrases
modes.description: A word after a distance or place that fixes where something is found.
modes.example: Most specimens are found within 80 km<< of>> the coast in a fog belt

card.writes: The promoted tokens are mixed word pieces about shape (flat, holes), so there is no clear output effect.
card.plain: It lights up on small connecting words in plain descriptions of landscapes, animals, plants and objects.
